findings.message: 286 of 328 test rows (87.2%) have exact copies in train. Only 31% of train rows are distinct, so repeats are expected for this data; this is a weaker signal.
69.0% of train rows repeat an earlier row on all features. With so few distinct rows this is probably natural to the data, not a pipeline bug.
68 groups of identical feature rows carry different targets (label noise or missing features).
A model separates train from test rows with AUC 0.513 (0.5 = indistinguishable, z = 0.7). Most shifted columns: age (0.51), passengerClass (0.50), sex (0.48).
